scripts.build: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --force && node scripts/build-agent.ts && node scripts/write-headers.ts && node scripts/build-feed.ts
scripts.test: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --force && node scripts/build-agent.ts && node scripts/write-headers.ts && node scripts/build-feed.ts && { node scripts/check.ts; c=$?; vitest run; v=$?; [ $c -eq 0 ] && [ $v -eq 0 ]; }
scripts.preview: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --force && node scripts/build-agent.ts && node scripts/write-headers.ts && node scripts/build-feed.ts && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev
scripts.preview:smoke: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --force && node scripts/build-agent.ts && node scripts/write-headers.ts && node scripts/build-feed.ts && node scripts/preview-smoke.ts
